laura-friedman.text: As an Assemblymember, authored a bill eliminating minimum parking requirements for housing near mass transit stations; it was signed into law in 2022.
In September 2021, delayed release of $4 billion in voter-approved high-speed rail bonds, saying the authority had "not provided us any real details about what the money would go towards this year."
Campaign priorities include "expanding access to affordable housing, supporting universal healthcare and childcare, strengthening economic security for families."
Campaign site says her record includes efforts to prevent gun violence, protect reproductive freedom, and defend the LGBTQ+ community.
Campaign site cites legislative work supporting people experiencing severe mental illness and homelessness.
Member of the Congressional Progressive Caucus; serves on House Transportation and Infrastructure and Science, Space, and Technology committees.
Endorsed by Abundant Housing Los Angeles (pro-housing-growth group).
Endorsed by Giffords PAC, Gun Sense Voter, Planned Parenthood Action Fund and Equality California.
Endorsed by the California Federation of Labor Unions, SEIU California, California Federation of Teachers and National Union of Healthcare Workers.
Endorsed by the League of Conservation Voters, Sierra Club, NRDC Action Fund and CA Environmental Voters.
